description: §6.7.7 a `deps=` entry that is a MEMBER ACCESS (`deps=[@u.id]`) is not a bare `@identifier` and fires E-LIFECYCLE-022. An explicit `deps=` overrides inference, so without the diagnostic the unrecognized entry left the request mount-only and silent. Twin of request-deps-non-cell-entry-e-lifecycle-022-neg (the same program listing the cell `@u`).
rationale: §6.7.7 grammar `deps-list ::= ('@' identifier (',' '@' identifier)*)?` and "The compiler SHALL emit E-LIFECYCLE-022 if a `deps=` entry names an undeclared or non-`@` variable." (S444 review fix round).
